text:
maria (Product): Quick sync request — for Q3 we need to lock launch criteria for the Latency Priority pilot (Acme, Beacon). Can infra/runtime/security commit to resource windows for prewarm + canary? ETA: confirm by EOD Wed.
aj (Run-time): What's the exact SLO we need? 95th or p99 target? current baseline for these customers is ~180ms p95.
tom (Infra): We can reserve 4 GPUs for a dedicated pilot pool, but need 2 weeks lead to schedule. Also need HSM prep for KMS if private keys required.
sasha (Eng-SRE): We'll need prewarm scripts + prefix cache config. I'll draft the runbook. Any constraints on quantization/variant selection?
maria (Product): Goal: p95 < 120ms end-to-end for text-gen at 512 tokens for pilot. No quant that degrades quality >1% on our eval prompts. Aim for zero cold-start; prefetch + prefix caching acceptable.
kevin (Security): KMS in our VPC path can be fast-tracked (~5 business days). On-prem HSM path is 3–4 weeks (compliance + procurement).
nora (Solutions Eng): Acme also needs an E2E pen-test signoff and audit logs for data handling — may add ~1 week. I'll coordinate with their SE.
emily (Product Ops): Action items: (1) Aj validate runtime perf on model v2-8q by Tue; (2) Tom confirm GPU window by Wed; (3) Kevin + Nora confirm KMS/HSM dates; (4) Sasha draft runbook by Thu. I'll spin a tracker doc and tag owners.
aj (Run-time): Starting perf sweeps today. Note: v2-8q trims ~20ms at p95 but increases variance at p99 — will test with real prompt set.
sasha (Eng-SRE): Canary plan: route 10% traffic -> pilot pool, 50% if healthy, else rollback. Quick ops snippet:
```
route set pilot_pool --weight 10
monitor latency p95,p99
```
maria (Product): Thanks all. If we get confirmations by Wed EOD we'll lock into the Q3 roadmap and begin customer comms. @kevin @tom @aj please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm.
deploy-bot: scheduled prewarm job created for 2023-04-13T03:00:00Z (id: pw-98321)
kevin (Security): Confirmed KMS VPC path — 5 days. :thumbsup:
tom (Infra): GPU window OK — reserving 4xA100 from 2023-04-20 to 2023-05-04. :thumbsup:
aj (Run-time): Perf sweep started; will post results in the tracker doc. :eyes:
emily (Product Ops): Great — locking action tracker and will follow up in #product-sync.
